decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on the 22nd November 2004, the proposed rear extension and outbuilding at 91 Bryon Avenue, Cranford, would not be lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:

The development does not fall within Class A Part 1 Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the cubic content of the resulting building would exceed the maximum permitted development volume of 50 cubic metres for development to a terraced dwelling.

The development fails to represent a structure required for 'a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse' given in the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 

A planning application for the proposed development would therefore be required.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of single storey rear extension and the erection of detached gamesroom in rear end of garden to dwellinghouse.
